scope: authoritative acquisition identities; not a T3 execution claim

s_niah.blocker: The RLM paper does not identify the RULER niah_single variant, tokenizer artifact/revision, package environment, generation seed, insertion depths, or the 50 generated instances used at each plotted length. The author confirmed in alexzhang13/rlm issue 28 that the benchmark/experiment repository was unavailable.

operator_query_selection.algorithm: sort all 830 IDs by SHA256(UTF8(decimal_seed + NUL + query_id)), query_id; take first 150

browsecomp_plus.required_validation: exactly 1000 unique document IDs; every official gold/evidence qrel ID present exactly once
browsecomp_plus.official_metrics: answer correctness by the pinned LLM-judge scorer; retrieval recall/nDCG by trec_eval against evidence and gold qrels
browsecomp_plus.blocker: The paper does not publish its 150 query IDs, document RNG, corpus order, evidence-selection behavior, or per-query ordered 1,000-document IDs. The public Query-74 trajectory contains no document manifest; the cited FoldAgent 150-row set is a different selection.

oolong.selection: all 50 validation rows where dataset=trec_coarse and context_len=131072, sorted by integer id
oolong.official_metric: numeric score 0.75^abs(gold-prediction); non-numeric exact match, per the OOLONG/RLM papers

oolong_pairs.operator_metric: versioned set precision/recall/F1 parser over normalized unordered user-ID pairs
oolong_pairs.scorer_authority: operator-defined; the paper-promised run_all.py pair scorer is not public, and the public OOLONG eval_helpers.py is not a pair scorer
oolong_pairs.blocker: Each context length has a different gold set, while the current normalized row contract permits only one scalar answer reused at all lengths. Exact paper scoring remains unavailable even after the schema is repaired.

longbench_v2_codeqa.selection: all 50 rows where domain=Code Repository Understanding and sub_domain=Code repo QA, preserving official order
